header.running_head: Rasulullaah ﷺ Endures Hardship and Difficulty when Giving Da'wah towards Allaah

blocks.text: When Rasulullaah ﷺ entered the Masjidul Haraam, he recited:

blocks.arabic_text: اِقْرَاْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ ۝ خَلَقَ الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ ۝
blocks.text: "Read in the name of your Rabb Who created (everything), created man from a clot of blood..."
Rasulullaah ﷺ continued reciting the Surah until he reached the verses referring to Abu Jahal, which read:

blocks.arabic_text: كَلَّآ اِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ لَيَطْغٰٓى ۝ اَنْ رَّاٰهُ اسْتَغْنٰى ۝
blocks.text: "It is a fact that man (the Kaafir like Abu Jahal) is rebellious (even exceeding the bounds of humanity) because he considers himself to be independent."

When someone informed Abu Jahal that Rasulullaah ﷺ had arrived, he said, "Do you not see what I see? By Allaah! The horizons have been shut before me!" Rasulullaah ﷺ then went into Sajdah when he had completed reciting the Surah.[^1]
Tulayb bin Umayr Avenges the harm that Abu Jahal Caused to Rasulullaah ﷺ

Hadhrat Barra bint Abi Tajra (RA) narrates that Abu Jahal and few others once approached Rasulullaah ﷺ and cause him much harm. Tulayb bin Umayr (RA) went to Abu Jahal and gave him a blow that wounded his head. When the other Mushrikeen grabbed hold of Tulayb (RA), Abu Lahab stood up to defend him. When news of the incident reached Hadhrat Arwa (RA) (Tulayb's mother), she exclaimed, "Verily, the best day of Tulayb's life is the day he assisted his cousin (Rasulullaah ﷺ)."

When Abu Lahab was told that (his sister) Hadhrat Arwa (RA) had accepted Islaam, he came to reproach her. She said, "You should also stand in defence of your nephew because if he dominates, you shall have some choice and if he does not, you will be excused because he is your nephew." Abu Lahab said, "Do we have strength (to fight) against all the Arabs? Nevertheless, he has introduced a religion."[^2]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Curses Utayba bin Abi Lahab because of the Hurt he caused and he is Eventually Killed
